name: NFKB inhibitor epsilon
pathways: negative regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction

function.text: NFKBIE encodes NF-kappa-B inhibitor epsilon. Annotated molecular activities include protein sequestering activity. It participates in negative regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia/Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma; Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma, NOS; Lung Adenocarcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
